notes.en:
• Collage: 11 new layouts for 1 to 12 photos — photo strips, grid wall, nine-grid tiles, film contact sheet, XPan vertical, half-frame pairs and more. Multi-page sets export in one go.
• Film borders, rebuilt: 11 formats from 35 mm, half-frame and XPan to 120 (645 up to 6×17), with edge print, DX code, frame numbers and an optional date stamp. Lettering stays crisp at full resolution.
• A film border never changes your picture: it only crops, and you choose the crop with Framing.
• New Camera Showcase template: your photo on the screen of a compact camera against a plaster wall, 3:4.
• The pop-out template has been removed. Presets that used it switch to Gallery Mat.
notes.zh-Hans:
• 拼图：11 种新版式，支持 1 到 12 张照片：横条拼接、照片墙、九宫格切图、胶卷条、XPan 竖幅、半格对拼等，多页一次导出。
• 胶片边框重做：11 种片幅，从 135、半格、XPan 到 120（645 至 6×17），带边码、DX 码、格号，可加日期背印；原尺寸下字迹清晰锐利。
• 胶片边框不改动画面，只做裁剪；裁剪范围在「取景」里自己选。
• 新模板「相机展示」：作品放进一台便携相机的屏幕，背后是石膏墙，整张 3:4。
• 移除「主体出框」模板，用过它的预设会改用「画廊卡纸」。
